filter__convolutionFeedback.mechanism: Iterative kernel convolution feedback accumulation; float32 accumulation drift on sparse high-gradient edges (770 of 65536 pixels, 1.2%).

filter__crt.mechanism: Scanline/phosphor-mask color math boundary ties at beam-intensity transitions (812 sparse pixels along mask rows).

filter__degauss.mechanism: Barrel-warp bilinear resample UV boundary ties at high-curvature pixels (175 single-channel flips).

filter__lensWarp.mechanism: Lens displacement UV bilinear tie at exactly one high-distortion pixel [178, 225].
